title: Phased capacity bundles pricing, partner enablement, and SLA migration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a cross-functional handbook detailing phased pricing for capacity bundles, migration paths for existing reservation customers to new SKUs, sales and partner enablement materials, and coordinated release notes for console/API and billing.
background: We are introducing new capacity bundle SKUs and a revised reservation pricing matrix for Dedicated. Flights from previous launches show confusion around billing migration and SLA applicability. This ticket consolidates operational runbooks and GTM assets across Sales, Billing, Console, Docs, and Support.
scope:
- Price matrix and migration rules for existing reservations
- Customer-facing migration FAQ and emails
- Release notes templates for Console, API, and Billing
- Sales enablement deck and partner onboarding checklist
- Runbook for ops to execute SLA adjustements and escalations
milestones: 2026-02-22 doc freeze and release notes publish
risks: Customer confusion leading to billing disputes
Edge cases in SLA start/end dates for migrating reservations
Partner collateral not localized in time
Billing pipeline changes causing invoice mismatches
mitigations: Run small pilot with 3 enterprise customers and billing team
Map migration logic for every edge case and include examples in FAQ
Prioritize localization for top 3 markets and delay others
Create reconciliation job in billing to detect invoice mismatches
communication_plan: Partner pilot email and private Slack channel
Public release notes + dedicated migration FAQ page
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix approved by Finance and Legal
Migration FAQ validated with billing test cases
Release notes published in Console and API changelog
Sales deck available in Drive and training scheduled
Support runbook uploaded and on-call aware of playbook
tasks: Eng: validate billing migration codepaths (assigned ENG-1842)
Legal: confirm pricing terms and SLA language
Docs: create FAQ and step-by-step migration guide
Support: simulate three migration cases and verify runbook
GTM: schedule webinar and partner pilot invites

owner_notes: Prefer soft migration window for high-value customers and opt-in notifications. Avoid forced swaps without two validation passes. Use the pilot to validate billing reconciliation before broad rollout.
open_questions: Should we grandfather SLA terms for customers with active multi-year commitments?
Do we auto-upgrade refunds if price decreases within first 30 days?
Which partner tier gets early access: Channel partners or direct enterprise resellers?

Run pilot migration for 3 customers starting 2026-02-16
